metadata.title: Urban Gritty Portrait with Geometric Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium shot of a male subject in urban attire sitting on weathered industrial stairs. The lighting is moody and directional, highlighting textures of leather and metal, while a large, stylized geometric gold title is positioned in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's leather jacket texture contrasting with the rusted metal stairs
Bright yellow graphic tee acting as a central color pop against dark surroundings
Gold metallic typography echoing the warm highlights on the subject's skin and jewelry
Diagonal lines of the stairs leading the eye toward the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left two-thirds of the frame, seated and leaning slightly forward, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary anchor, supported by the bright yellow shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the yellow shirt, follows the diagonal of the stairs up to the gold text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas in the top left and bottom right provide breathing room for the busy textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns (leather, shadows, rusted metal)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Acid yellow (graphic t-shirt) providing a central focal point
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold (typography and jewelry) adding a sense of luxury
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between deep shadows and bright yellow; saturation is concentrated in the shirt and text.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical terminals on specific characters (e.g., J and M)
Horizontal bars aligned to a high midline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' features a long descender that hooks sharply
The 'M' has a deep V-shape reaching the baseline
The 'H' features a crossbar positioned above the center
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; no secondary text.
graphicDevices: Distressed texture on the t-shirt print

candidateDirections.reason: Similar geometric and architectural feel with thin strokes
Captures the high crossbars and sharp points

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with short hair and sunglasses wearing a black leather jacket over a bright yellow graphic t-shirt, sitting on dark, rusted industrial metal stairs. Moody lighting with high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, thin-stroke geometric uppercase title in the top right corner with a gold metallic gradient and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow shirt the brightest element in the photo?
Does the gold text have a metallic gradient effect?
Are the stairs visibly rusted and textured?
Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?

adjustableVariables: Amount of rust on the stairs
Specific character extensions in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the clothing
Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Cartoonish or overly saturated colors (except the yellow shirt)

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the background
Leather texture is visible and detailed
The yellow shirt does not wash out the subject's skin tones
The composition maintains the 2/3 subject placement
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Industrial Texture + Geometric Gold Display Type
